item.title: CVE-2025-55182 · React2Shell: RCE in React Server Components via Prototype Pollution
item.description:
TL;DR: React’s Flight deserializer evaluates any object with a .then method as a Promise, regardless of its actual type. An attacker poisons Object.prototype.then through a crafted multipart POST, forcing the server to execute arbitrary JavaScript via the Function constructor. The result is exfiltrated through the X-Action-Redirect HTTP header as a redirect parameter. No authentication required. Deterministic. CVSS v3.1: 10.0 (Critical).

1. Context — React Server Components and the Attack Surface

React Server Components (RSC) were introduced experimentally in React 18 and stabilized as a production-ready feature in React 19, alongside Server Actions: a model where UI components execute directly on the server and communicate with the client through a custom serialization layer called the Flight protocol. When the client invokes a Server Action, it sends a multipart POST request with a serialized payload. The server deserializes it, executes the action, and streams back the result.
